failures.criterion: The pull request merges into main and CI runs at its head (the bare gate this phase reads CI from)
failures.evidence: gh pr view 2451 --repo sjawhar/legion --json mergeable,mergeStateStatus → CONFLICTING / DIRTY against main@origin aeeee6c029f6. gh api repos/sjawhar/legion/commits/{0483541b8cbe,7d4ac2498d81}/check-runs and actions/runs?head_sha=0483541b8cbe return no runs at all: GitHub builds no merge ref for a conflicting head, so no CI result exists to read. git merge-tree --write-tree aeeee6c029f6 0483541b8cbe: the only conflict is packages/envoy/CHANGELOG.md (CONFLICT (content)); edits.go and AGENTS.md auto-merge, and the trial merge tree bbc3389a builds (GOWORK=off go build ./... and go vet ./internal/dispatch/docs/ ./internal/dispatch/pmdoc/ OK). Cause: main took #2419 (184897acc, 'changelog entries are fragment files'), which renamed '## [Unreleased]' to '## Before changelog fragments' and, in AGENTS.md on main, says an entry goes in packages/<pkg>/.changes/unreleased/<ISSUE KEY>-<slug>.yaml (kind: Changed, body: |- …) and that 'an open pull request that added an entry under the old ## [Unreleased] heading moves the entry into a fragment the next time it merges main'. Fix: merge main into legion/INFRA-649 (conflicts-and-rewrites.md, forward merge from the bookmark), drop this PR's CHANGELOG.md hunk, and add packages/envoy/.changes/unreleased/INFRA-649-<slug>.yaml with kind Changed and the same body. No red test pins this: it is a merge conflict and a file-layout rule, not product behaviour; the evidence is the merge-tree command above.
